title: pump survives a throwing request

commit.merge_subject: merge: pump survives a throwing request

description:
The preview render pump (LaunchedEffect(sourceId), the
for(kick)/while(true) loop in ClipEditorScreen) had no guard
around its per-request body: renderInFlight=true sat at the
top, the =false reset at the bottom was PLAIN — not in a
finally. Anything that threw a non-cancellation throwable in
between (the realistic throwers: PublishCrop.resample's bitmap
path at 12MP — OutOfMemoryError / an IllegalArgumentException
on geometry, the one genuinely-throwing call in the body; a
native bridge failure escaping as a RuntimeException instead
of Result.failure; a RenderTrace record construction) landed
TWO failures at once: renderInFlight stayed true forever
(EditorPreviewLogic.stateOf reports RENDERING forever — the
eternal spinner over the preview), and the exception unwound
out of the for-loop, killing the whole LaunchedEffect — every
later request queued and never rendered for the rest of the
changed: hardening: pump survives a throwing request
